displayTitle: Super Graphic: A Visual Guide to a Galaxy Far, Far Away
synopsis: Graphic design guru Tim Leong presents Star Wars trivia in an all-new way - through playful pie charts, bar graphs, and other data-driven infographics. From a Venn diagram of Yoda's idiosyncrasies to an organizational chart of the Empire to a line graph of Grand Moff Tarkin's management decisions, Star Wars Super Graphic shines a new light on the much-adored universe. Equal parts playful and informative, this visual love letter to the vast Star Wars universe will enchant fans of all ages.
title: Star Wars Super Graphic: A Visual Guide to a Galaxy Far, Far Away
